categories.label: Filing Formalities
categories.prompt: Assess Form 28 for this SLP (Civil): court and jurisdiction caption, party positions, the petition body, mandatory declarations, grounds, prayers, and any supporting affidavit this task names. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score other Form 28 points, other categories, or legal merit.

categories.label: Advocate's Check List
categories.prompt: Assess the Advocate's Check List and the Advocate-on-Record's certificate on this filing, including the signature block. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Listing Proforma
categories.prompt: Assess the Listing Proforma (Proforma for First Listing) that accompanies the filing. Decide only whether the columns or particulars named in this task are duly filled. Do not score other listing fields unless this task names them.

categories.label: Petition Presentation
categories.prompt: Assess the form of the petition: paper, spacing, font, margins, numbering, signatures and endorsements. Decide only the objection in the user message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Applications
categories.prompt: Assess interlocutory or miscellaneous applications named in this task (condonation, substitution, caveat, permission to appear). Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Annexures
categories.prompt: Assess the annexures: markings, true copies, order, and match to the Index or List of Dates. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Parties and Cause Title
categories.prompt: Assess the cause title, Memo of Parties, and party particulars named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Drafting and Execution Dates
categories.prompt: Assess the drafting date of the petition relative to filing, the supporting affidavit and the Vakalatnama. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Index and Paper Book
categories.prompt: Assess the common index, running pagination, and Part I / Part II (or volume) arrangement of the paper book. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Limitation
categories.prompt: Assess the Office Report on Limitation and any condonation of delay for a time-barred petition named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Affidavit
categories.prompt: Assess the supporting affidavit named in this task: presence, form, swearing, exhibits and blanks. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Translations
categories.prompt: Assess translations of vernacular documents, official translation or exemption, and translated powers of attorney. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Vakalatnama
categories.prompt: Assess the Vakalatnama: execution, acceptance, executant particulars and related endorsements. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: Memo of Appearance
categories.prompt: Assess the Memo of Appearance named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

categories.label: List of Dates
categories.prompt: Assess the List of Dates and Events named in this task. Decide only the objection in this message. Do not score sibling defects in this area.

defects.special_category: Civil Appeal with High Court Certificate
defects.defect: Judgments/orders of the Court below referred to or relied upon in the impugned judgment/order, which are relevant for explaining the history and background of the case, are not annexed with the appeal.
defects.requirement: In appeals falling under Order XIX Rule 6 of the Supreme Court Rules, 2013, the appeal must be accompanied by a certified copy (or an uncertified copy affirmed by affidavit as a true copy) of the judgment or order and the decree of the court immediately below or, where applicable, the order of the Tribunal, Government authority or other person. In other words, Copies of the judgments/orders of the Court below referred to or relied upon in the impugned judgment/order and relevant for explaining the history and background of the case shall be annexed with the appeal. Such copies need not necessarily be certified copies.
where_to_look: 1. Check the Annexures accompanying the Appeal for the judgment/order and decree of the Court immediately below, or the relevant order of the Tribunal, Government authority or other person, as applicable.
2. Check the documents filed for the certification/attestation status of the judgment, order or decree to verify that a certified copy has been filed.
3. Where an uncertified copy has been filed, check the Affidavit accompanying the Appeal for a specific affirmation that the copy is a true copy of the original.
4. Check that the judgment/order and decree or applicable order correspond to the decision challenged in the appeal and cross-check the particulars against the appeal petition.
how_to_cure: 1. If available:
1.1. Upload certified copy
2. If not available:
2.1. Upload uncertified copy
2.2. Upload affidavit affirming it to be a true copy
defects.applicable_rule: Order XIX Rule 6 of the Rules

defects.special_category: Criminal Appeal with High Court Certificate
defects.defect: The appeal is not accompanied by a certified copy (or an uncertified copy affirmed by affidavit as a true copy) of the judgment or order of the court immediately below.
defects.requirement: In appeals falling under Order XX Rule 5(1) of the Supreme Court Rules, 2013, namely (i) appeals against a judgment, final order or sentence of a High Court summarily dismissing a criminal appeal or other criminal proceeding; (ii) certificate appeals where the High Court has granted a certificate under Article 134A in respect of an appeal under Article 132(1) or Article 134(1)(c), or under any other provision of law, without recording reasons or grounds for granting the certificate; or (iii) appeals under Section 19(1)(b) of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971, against an order or decision of a Bench of a High Court in the exercise of its contempt jurisdiction, the appeal shall be accompanied by a certified copy (or an uncertified copy affirmed by affidavit as a true copy) of the judgment or order of the court immediately below.
where_to_look: 1. Check after all Annexures, the judgment/order and the corresponding decree of the court below the High Court, or the court from which the impugned judgment/order arises.
2. If the copies filed are not certified, check the Affidavit filed after the Main Petition for an averment affirming them to be true copies.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for the User to upload the certified copy of the of the judgment or order of the court.
2.1. Option for  the User to upload the uncertified copies of the documents.

2.2. Option for Jubeex to draft an affidavit affirming that the copies are true copies of the documents forming part of the record of the Court sought to be appealed from, and prompt the User to have it duly sworn and upload the duly sworn affidavit with Jubeex.
2.3.  Option for the User to upload the affidavit with Jubeex.

defects.defect: The petition for review of a case or application has been filed after the expiry of a period of thirty days from the date of the order, however, it is not accompanied by an application seeking condonation of delay.
defects.requirement: The petition for review of a case or application has been filed after the expiry of a period of thirty days from the date of the order must be accompanied by an application seeking condonation of delay.
where_to_look: 1. Check the date of the order sought to be reviewed and the date of filing of the Review Petition/Application.
2. Calculate whether the filing is beyond 30 days from the date of the order.
3. If there is a delay, check the Index and list of applications to verify whether an application for condonation of delay has been filed along with the Review Petition/Application.
how_to_cure: 1. File an Application for Condonation of Delay explaining the reasons for the delay.
2. The application should be filed along with the Review Petition/Application and supported by the requisite affidavit.

defects.defect: Annexures not certified copies / uncertified copies not affirmed to be true copies

where_to_look: 1. Check the Annexures accompanying the petition for the documents relied upon and verify that the copies filed are certified copies.
2. Check each annexure to verify that the document forms part of the record before the Court or Tribunal sought to be appealed from.
3. Where an annexure is an uncertified copy, check the  Affidavit accompanying the main Petition/SLP for an affirmation that the copy filed is a true copy of the original.
4. Cross-check the annexures against the record of the Court or Tribunal below, where available, to verify that the documents correspond to those forming part of the record.

defects.main_category: SLP (Criminal)/Criminal Appeal/Writ Petition (Criminal)/Transfer Petition (Criminal)/Review Petition (Criminal)/Contempt Petition (Criminal)/Curative Petition (Criminal)
defects.defect: Despite the matter involving a sentence to a term of imprisonment, the petitioner has neither stated that he has surrendered nor has an application for exemption from surrendering been filed.
defects.requirement: In matters involving sentence to a term of imprisonment, the petitioner must state that he has surrendered OR application for exemption from surrendering has been filed
defects.trigger_words: Sentence to a term of imprisonment, Surrender, Application for exemption from surrender
where_to_look: 1.Check the Impugned Judgment/Trial Court Order to determine whether a sentence of imprisonment has been imposed.
2. If a sentence of imprisonment has been imposed, check the Main Petition for a statement that the petitioner has surrendered.
3. Check the Annexures for any document serving as proof of surrender.
4. If the petitioner has not surrendered, check the Applications placed after the Annexures for an application seeking exemption from surrendering.
5. Verify that either a statement of surrender or an application for exemption from surrendering is present.
how_to_cure: 1. Prompt the User to specify whether the petitioner has surrendered or seeks exemption from surrendering. If exemption is sought, Jubeex will auto-generate the application seeking exemption from surrendering.
2.  Option for User to upload the  application seeking exemption from surrendering.

defects.main_category: SLP (Criminal)/Criminal Appeal/Writ Petition (Criminal)/Transfer Petition (Criminal)/Review Petition (Criminal)/Contempt Petition (Criminal)/Curative Petition (Criminal)
defects.defect:
The date of attestation on the vakalatnama by the Jail
Superintendent is not of the same or subsequent to the date on which
it was executed by the accused person.
defects.requirement: The date of attestation on the vakalatnama by the Jail Superintendent shall be the same or subsequent to the date on which it was executed by the accused person.
where_to_look: 1. Check the Vakalatnama at the end of the file for the date on which it was executed by the accused.
2. Check the attestation/endorsement of the Jail Superintendent on the same Vakalatnama for its date, as the date of attestation must be the same as or after the date of execution by the accused.
how_to_cure: 1. Upload the final vakalatnama as signed & stamped by the Jail Superintendent

defects.main_category: SLP (Criminal)/Criminal Appeal/Writ Petition (Criminal)/Transfer Petition (Criminal)/Review Petition (Criminal)/Contempt Petition (Criminal)/Curative Petition (Criminal)
defects.defect: A proof of surrender i.e. the certified copy of the order of the Court in which Petitioner has surrendered or a certificate of competent officer of the jail in which he is undergoing the sentence- has not been filed
defects.requirement: In matters involving sentence to a term of imprisonment, as a proof of surrender, the certified copy of the order of the Court in which Petitioner has surrendered or a certificate of competent officer of the jail in which he is undergoing the sentence must be filed
defects.trigger_words: Sentence of imprisonment, surrender, undergoing sentence, Certificate of the appropriate jail officer (i.e. from the same jail he is undergoing the sentence)
where_to_look: 1. Check the Listing proforma for declaration regarding whether accused/convict has surrendered
2. Check the judgement/order for such disclosure
3. Check for Custody certificate usually located after the annexures
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload the certified copy of the surrender order passed by the Court or the certificate of the competent officer of the jail, as applicable.

defects.main_category: SLP (Criminal)/Criminal Appeal/Writ Petition (Criminal)/Transfer Petition (Criminal)/Review Petition (Criminal)/Contempt Petition (Criminal)/Curative Petition (Criminal)
defects.defect: In an undertrial matter where the petitioner is in custody, the required proof of custody/surrender issued or attested by the competent jail authority has not been filed separately for each petitioner, and no application seeking exemption from filing separate proof of surrender has been filed.
defects.requirement: In an undertrial matter, where the petitioner is in custody, proof of custody/surrender issued or attested by the competent jail authority must be filed separately for each petitioner. Where separate proof is not being filed for each petitioner, an application seeking exemption from filing separate proofs of surrender must be filed.
defects.trigger_words: Undertrial case, Application for exemption from filing separate proof of surrender
where_to_look: 1.Check whether the matter is an undertrial case and identify all the petitioners.
2. Check the Vakalatnama to verify whether it has been attested by the competent jail authority as proof of surrender.
3. Verify that the jail-attested Vakalatnama has been filed separately in respect of each petitioner.

4. If a separate jail-attested Vakalatnama has not been filed for any petitioner, check the Applications placed after the Annexures for an application seeking exemption from filing separate proof of surrender.
5. Verify that the application covers each petitioner for whom separate proof of surrender has not been filed.
how_to_cure: 1. Prompt the User to confirm whether a separate Vakalatnama attested by the competent jail authority has been filed for each petitioner. If not, Jubeex will auto-generate the application seeking exemption from filing separate proof of surrender.
2. Option for the User to upload the application seeking exemption from filing separate proof of surrender with Jubeex.

4. Check the same Affidavit for a clear statement setting out the nature and circumstances of the restraint, including the circumstances in which the person is being detained or restrained.
5. Check the deponent details and signature/verification in the Affidavit to confirm that the affidavit has been made by the person restrained
